title: Verify Senior Service Advisor can delete a work order
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Senior Service Advisor role. (this role has Work Orders: Delete).
The work order is in Uncomplete status (a work order must be Uncomplete before it can be deleted).
steps:
1. Open the Uncomplete work order.
2. Open the work order action menu and click Delete.
3. Confirm the deletion.
expected: The work order is deleted and no longer appears in the Work Orders list.
